title: 促销订单突然增加，怎样快速补上履约能力？
topic: 把仓储、人手和配送整合成一套应急方案

source.title: UPS helps Singapore exporter deliver nearly 10,000 orders under pressure
source.section: UPS helps Singapore exporter deliver nearly 10,000 orders under pressure
source.type: UPS 官方新加坡客户履约与临时扩容案例
source.context: UPS 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: Ahead of a major sales event, Singapore-based exporter Well Done Solutions realized they were going to need help packing and shipping a surge of orders. So they turned to UPS.

Building on a strong foundation: We already handled small package shipments for Well Done Solutions. But this sudden increase required more support, including warehousing, order fulfillment and delivery. Because we already knew the customer’s business, we could move quickly and bring the right UPS solutions together.

Creating a solution – fast: With no time to spare, UPS teams in Singapore stood up a temporary warehouse equipped with everything from staffing to shelving – a process that can sometimes take months. The mission: turn bulk inventory into thousands of individual shipments as quickly as possible. And we delivered. Within just 48 hours, our pop-up warehouse was sending packages to U.S.-based shoppers.

The advantage of an end-to-end network: Because we managed both the warehouse operations and the global delivery network, inventory flowed seamlessly from receiving to processing to shipping without the need to transfer between multiple providers.
This end-to-end approach – connecting fulfillment and transportation within a single network – helps reduce complexity, increase speed and improve reliability, especially during high-demand moments.

“UPS helped us get through one of the most challenging business environments we’ve faced in recent years,” said Rennis Lau, director of Well Done Solutions. “We needed a partner we could trust, one that delivers not just packages, but reliability, solutions and peace of mind. That’s exactly what they gave us.”
translations: 大型促销活动前，位于新加坡的出口商 Well Done Solutions 意识到订单即将激增，需要人手协助打包和发运，于是联系了 UPS。
此前，我们已经为 Well Done Solutions 处理小包裹运输。但这次订单突然增加，需要更多支持，包括仓储、订单履约和配送。因为我们已经了解客户的业务，所以可以快速行动并组合合适的 UPS 解决方案。
快速搭建解决方案：时间紧迫，新加坡的 UPS 团队搭建了一座临时仓库，配齐员工、货架等设施；这样的流程有时需要数月。目标是尽快把大批库存拆分成数千个独立包裹。我们做到了。仅用 48 小时，临时仓库就开始向美国消费者发货。
端到端网络的优势：由于仓库运营和全球配送网络都由我们管理，库存从收货、处理到发运顺畅流转，无需在多个服务商之间转交。
这种端到端方式把履约与运输连接在同一个网络中，有助于降低复杂度、提高速度和可靠性，尤其适用于需求高峰。
“UPS 帮助我们度过了近几年最具挑战性的经营环境之一，”Well Done Solutions 董事 Rennis Lau 说。“我们需要一位值得信赖的合作伙伴。他交付的不只是包裹，还有可靠性、解决方案和安心感。这正是他们带给我们的。”
fullTextParagraphs: This story celebrates People Powering Growth – UPSers around the world who are helping our business grow by putting customers first, leading with our values and driving innovation.
Ahead of a major sales event, Singapore-based exporter Well Done Solutions realized they were going to need help packing and shipping a surge of orders. So they turned to UPS.

Building on a strong foundation: We already handled small package shipments for Well Done Solutions. But this sudden increase required more support, including warehousing, order fulfillment and delivery. Because we already knew the customer’s business, we could move quickly and bring the right UPS solutions together.
“Our customers are always looking to grow,” said UPS Account Executive Cindy Chong. “And when demand spikes, we’ve got the end-to-end logistics network to help them move quickly.”

Creating a solution – fast: With no time to spare, UPS teams in Singapore stood up a temporary warehouse equipped with everything from staffing to shelving – a process that can sometimes take months. The mission: turn bulk inventory into thousands of individual shipments as quickly as possible. And we delivered. Within just 48 hours, our pop-up warehouse was sending packages to U.S.-based shoppers.

The advantage of an end-to-end network: Because we managed both the warehouse operations and the global delivery network, inventory flowed seamlessly from receiving to processing to shipping without the need to transfer between multiple providers.
This end-to-end approach – connecting fulfillment and transportation within a single network – helps reduce complexity, increase speed and improve reliability, especially during high-demand moments.

“UPS helped us get through one of the most challenging business environments we’ve faced in recent years,” said Rennis Lau, director of Well Done Solutions. “We needed a partner we could trust, one that delivers not just packages, but reliability, solutions and peace of mind. That’s exactly what they gave us.”

scenario.title: 模拟情境：大促前订单量预计翻倍
english: A Singapore-based seller expects a sharp order increase in five days.
Its current warehouse can handle normal demand, but staffing and shipping capacity are already close to the limit.
Propose a temporary fulfillment setup, name the resources to connect, and give a launch target and service measure.
chinese: 一家新加坡卖家预计五天后订单量会大幅增加。
现有仓库能处理日常需求，但人手和配送能力已经接近上限。
请提出临时履约方案，说清要整合的资源、启用时间和服务指标。

firstAttempt.prompt: 促销将在五天后开始，仓库和人手不足。请用英语提出临时仓储方案，说明要整合哪些资源、何时启用，以及如何确保订单按时发出。
firstAttempt.sample: We should set up a temporary warehouse before the promotion and bring warehousing, fulfillment, and delivery together. We can add staff and shelving at the site. Our target should be to start shipping orders within 48 hours of setup. We will track the backlog and on-time shipping each day so we can add capacity quickly if demand rises further.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先提出临时仓库，再说明整合的资源、启用目标和每天要看的履约指标。

words.example: We need extra capacity to handle a surge in orders.
words.translation: 我们需要额外产能来应对订单激增。

words.meaning: 订单履约；订单处理与交付
words.example: The new partner will support order fulfillment during the peak.
words.translation: 新合作方会在高峰期支持订单履约。
words.note: 通常包括拣货、打包和发运等环节。

words.example: A shared network can reduce handoffs between providers.
words.translation: 共享网络可以减少服务商之间的交接。
words.note: 多个环节由不同团队或供应商处理时常用。

taskPhrases.word: bring warehousing, fulfillment, and delivery together
taskPhrases.meaning: 整合仓储、订单履约和配送
taskPhrases.example: We should bring warehousing and delivery together.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们应该把仓储和配送整合起来。

taskPhrases.collocation: set up + a temporary site / team / process
taskPhrases.example: We can set up a temporary warehouse near the port.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们可以在港口附近搭建临时仓库。

taskPhrases.word: start shipping orders within 48 hours of setup
taskPhrases.meaning: 在 48 小时内开始处理订单
taskPhrases.example: The team should start shipping orders within 48 hours of setup.
taskPhrases.translation: 团队应在场地搭建后的 48 小时内开始发运订单。

structure.original: This end-to-end approach – connecting fulfillment and transportation within a single network – helps reduce complexity, increase speed and improve reliability, especially during high-demand moments.
analysis: connecting… 是对 end-to-end approach 的补充说明：把履约和运输放进同一网络。
helps 后接三个并列动词：reduce、increase、improve。
especially during… 指出高峰期更需要这类做法。
structure.transfer: A shared service desk connects intake and resolution in one workflow, helping reduce delays and improve reliability.

rewrite.bad: We need to ship more orders. Let’s ask another company.
rewrite.good: We should bring warehousing, fulfillment, and delivery together for the promotion. A temporary site with extra staff and shelving should start shipping orders within 48 hours of setup. We will review backlog and on-time shipping each day.
rewrite.translation: 我们应该为促销整合仓储、订单履约和配送。配备额外员工和货架的临时场地应在搭建后的 48 小时内开始发运订单。我们会每天查看积压订单和按时发货情况。
rewrite.pattern: We should bring [services] together. A temporary [site / team] can start [work] within [time]. We’ll review [service measures] each day.

cloze.prompt: We need extra capacity to handle a ______ in orders.
cloze.why: surge in orders 表示订单激增。

cloze.prompt: The team should start ______ orders within 48 hours of setting up the temporary site.
cloze.why: start shipping orders 表示开始发运订单；within 48 hours of setting up the site 说明开始时间，不代表 48 小时内处理完全部订单。

cloze.prompt: A shared network can reduce ______ between providers.
cloze.why: handoffs 是多个服务方之间的交接。

choice.prompt: 促销前五天，预测显示订单将翻倍，但团队还没有核实各环节产能。哪种处理方式更稳妥？
options: Promise same-day delivery for every order before checking capacity.
Bring warehouse, staffing, and delivery teams together, confirm capacity, and set a launch target with daily backlog checks.
Wait until the promotion starts, then contact a new provider.
choice.why: 第二种做法先核实各环节，再设启用目标并每日检查积压，能更早补充产能。

output.prompt: 你要向运营负责人提议为促销设置临时仓库。请说清要接入的资源、启用时限，以及每天如何检查履约。
output.sample: We should set up a temporary warehouse and bring staffing, order fulfillment, and delivery into one operating plan. The site should start shipping orders within 48 hours of setup. We can review the backlog and on-time shipping daily and add capacity if the order surge is higher than forecast.
check: 明确临时仓储方案和整合资源
提出可检查的启用时限
说明每天追踪的履约指标
